story.title: Story 3: Message Projection and Token Estimates

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on F-03-001 and directly touched schema-open, message write/read, and migration-test surfaces. The prior Story 2 schema migration blocker is resolved, but the new lazy-upgrade path now treats arbitrary existing non-thread files as migratable thread files and can return successful message read-back after creating LHC tables without metadata.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved. `packages/lhc/src/domains/threads/internal/create.ts:22-78` now keeps v1 as the accepted Story 2 schema and appends v2 for `message`/`message_block`; `openThreadDatabase` runs migrations before returning at `create.ts:85-93`. `runMessageEvents`, `runListEvents`, and `listMessages` now open through `openThreadDatabase` (`pipeline.ts:100-106`, `pipeline.ts:227-230`, `messages/index.ts:92-97`). `test/thread-migration.test.ts:35-130` verifies Story 2 user_version=1 files upgrade before write/read, preserve existing event content, continue event order with `m2`, return empty messages on read-only upgrade, and keep legacy idempotency keys skipping without duplicate messages. Focused `vitest run test/thread-migration.test.ts`, `test/projection.test.ts`, `green-verify`, and `verify-all` all passed.

newFindings.title: Lazy upgrade creates thread schema on arbitrary existing files
newFindings.evidence: `openThreadDatabase` unconditionally opens the supplied path and runs `runMigrations(db, buildThreadMigrations())` in `packages/lhc/src/domains/threads/internal/create.ts:85-89`. When no creation metadata is passed, v1 creates `thread_metadata` without inserting the required singleton row (`create.ts:25-44`). `messages.listMessages` then calls this opener and returns `ok: true` from `readMessages` (`packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/index.ts:84-98`). A TSX probe against an existing empty file showed `messages.listMessages({ filePath })` returned `{ ok:true, value:[] }`, changed `PRAGMA user_version` from 0 to 2, and created `event`, `message`, `message_block`, and `thread_metadata` tables; a later `messageEvents` call failed with `thread file has no metadata row`. This is a newly introduced production-path regression: read-back succeeds and mutates a non-thread file instead of rejecting an invalid thread file without creating app schema.
requirementIds: Definition of Done: listMessages ordered and deterministic

verified: F-03-001 / existing Story 2 user_version=1 files: verified by `test/thread-migration.test.ts`; messageEvents and listMessages migrate valid legacy thread files before write/read, preserve existing events, continue dense event order, and keep legacy idempotency skips inert for messages.
AC-2.2 through AC-2.6 and AC-5.4 remain covered by the existing Story 3 projection suite; focused `test/projection.test.ts` passed after the migration fix.
Configured story gate `green-verify` passed with 59 tests and Red test immutability OK; epic gate `verify-all` passed with 69 tests including process-boundary suites.
unverified: Production-path handling for existing non-thread files supplied as `{ filePath }`: the directly touched lazy-upgrade path currently creates LHC tables and can return successful `listMessages` output without a metadata row.

productionPathFindings: F-03-002: the lazy schema-upgrade opener mutates arbitrary existing files into partial LHC thread databases and allows `messages.listMessages` to return success without a thread metadata row.
additionalObservations: The F-03-001 fix uses a real versioned migration path, not a fake adapter or test-only branch, and the migration tests enter through production SDK surfaces plus below-SDK schema reads.
The configured gates pass, but they do not cover the non-thread existing-file regression exposed in F-03-002.
Remaining `notImplemented` surfaces are still planned future-story surfaces and were not material to this follow-up finding.
